results.description:
Sleep takes up one-third of your life — Let’s make it truly restorative with Snoozy.

Join millions improving their sleep every night with Snoozy — the all-in-one app for tracking, understanding, and transforming your rest. From scientific sleep tracking to soothing audio, relaxation tools, and even AI-powered dream insights — Snoozy helps you wake up refreshed, calm, and ready for the day.

OUR UNIQUE FEATURES:
— Sleep Cycle Tracking
Understand your Light, Deep, and REM sleep stages. Snoozy uses advanced algorithms to analyze your patterns and provide detailed daily, weekly, and monthly reports — just place your phone nearby while you rest.

— Sleep Sound Analysis
Record snoring, sleep talking, or other nighttime sounds. Identify disturbances and get insights that support lifestyle improvements or medical discussions.

— Heart Rate Monitor
Track your heart rate through the night to see how stress, rest, and recovery affect your body. Snoozy helps you discover the connection between your heartbeat and your sleep quality.

— AI Dream Interpretation
Wake up curious? Log your dreams and let Snoozy’s AI provide insightful, personalized interpretations based on symbols, emotions, and patterns — blending science with self-reflection.

— Personalized Sleep Notes
Record your mood, caffeine intake, and daily habits to see how they impact your sleep. Snoozy helps you uncover what truly affects your nights — and your mornings.

— Smart Alarm & Bedtime Reminders
Wake up gently during your lightest sleep phase, and stay consistent with smart reminders that help you build healthy sleep routines.

— White Noise & Sound Library
Drift off faster with soothing white noise, nature sounds, ambient tracks, ASMR, and guided meditations. Create your perfect soundscape for deep, undisturbed rest.

— Yoga & Relaxation for Sleep
Follow simple guided stretches and breathing exercises before bed. Release tension, ease your mind, and prepare your body for natural sleep.

— Expert Articles & Sleep Education
Learn from sleep science. Explore topics like sleep hygiene, circadian rhythm, and the psychology of rest — written by wellness professionals.

— Apple Health Sync
Easily sync your sleep and heart rate data with Apple Health for a complete view of your wellness.

Why We Choose Snoozy?
• Tired even after 8 hours of sleep?
• Curious if you snore or talk in your sleep?
• Searching for natural ways to relax and fall asleep faster?
• Want to understand your dreams or improve your overall well-being?

Snoozy gives you all the tools to take control of your nights — and energize your days.

Snoozy Is For:
√ Anyone struggling with poor sleep or fatigue
√ People curious about their sleep behavior and dreams
√ Those who prefer natural, non-medicated sleep improvement
√ Wellness-focused users syncing data with Apple Health
√ Busy professionals, students, and anyone needing deeper rest

Wake up to brighter mornings with Snoozy — sleep better, live better.

Disclaimer:
Snoozy is designed for general wellness and lifestyle improvement purposes. It is not a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment. For any sleep disorder concerns, consult a healthcare professional. Audio and heart rate tracking require device permissions and compliance with local privacy laws.

Subscription & In-App Purchase Info:
- Payment charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation
- Auto-renews unless turned off 24 hours before current period ends
- Manage your subscription anytime in Account Settings
- Any unused trial portion is forfeited upon subscription purchase

Own your sleep health journey today with Snoozy!

SnoozeProof is the alarm clock that gets you out of bed.

No snooze bargaining. No drifting back to sleep.

Dismiss the alarm only after you complete a wake up challenge. Join 10,000+ people on the SnoozeProof waitlist & newsletter building consistent mornings.

WHY IT WORKS

Most alarms rely on sound. SnoozeProof forces activation, movement, and attention, the 3 things your brain needs to fully wake up. It also features optional extra loud alarms.

WAKE UP CHALLENGES* 

• QR Code Mission: scan a code in your bathroom, kitchen, or gym
• Math Mission: solve quick problems to snap your focus on
• Task Missions: simple actions that force you to move
• Multi Step Routines: stack missions so you cannot “half wake” and roll over

WIN REAL PRIZES EVERY WEEK* **

Waking up early should pay off. Complete your morning alarm and you're automatically entered into our weekly prize draw. One real winner every week: AirPods, gift cards, and more. The more mornings you win, the more entries you earn. No luck required, just consistency.

COMPETE WITH FRIENDS IN LEAGUES*

Turn your mornings into a game. Start a private league with up to 8 friends, family, or teammates. Score points for every on-time wake-up. Climb the weekly leaderboard. Get a notification the moment someone passes you, and the satisfaction when you pass them back. Accountability beats willpower.

BUILT FOR HEAVY SLEEPERS AND CHRONIC SNOOZERS

Recommended for:
• People who set 5 alarms minutes apart
• Anyone who wakes up, snoozes, and forgets
• Early workouts, early meetings, school, and shift work
• Anyone rebuilding consistency after burnout or bad sleep

CONSISTENCY FEATURES* 

• No Snooze Mode: remove the escape hatch
• Repeat schedules and labels for real life routines
• Progress tracking: see what works and improve your mornings
• Fast setup, no clutter, no distractions

PRIVACY AND CONTROL
Your alarms and stats stay on your device by default. Easily opt out of data sharing.

Make tomorrow morning automatic. Set SnoozeProof once, and wake up on time.

results.description:
Create magical bedtime stories personalized for your child.

Choose a world, mood, and storytelling style, then generate a unique story in seconds. Children can become part of the adventure, making every bedtime feel special and immersive.

Features:
• Personalized AI-generated bedtime stories
• Multiple fantasy worlds and story vibes
• High-quality narrated voices for storytelling
• Kid-friendly and calming bedtime experience
• New unique stories every time

Designed to make bedtime more engaging, imaginative, and relaxing for kids and parents alike.

According to scientific research, listening to tranquil music and soothing sounds before going to bed reduces anxiety by up to 60%. It also improves the quality of sleep right on the first night! 

So let’s catch some Zzz’s together – with snoozy! 

How to use snoozy?

First, create compositions in the app that will put you in a good mood and state of relaxation.

We recommend that you: 
- Use an acupressure mat (if you have one).
- Light up a fragrance lamp (if you have one). Scents like lavender, sandalwood, eucalyptus, bergamot and jasmine positively affect the quality of your sleep. 
- Turn off the lights.
- Once you're ready, lie down and relax and put on your favorite tune from snoozy. You can set the timer so that it will turn off automatically.

Also, remember to take care of your sleep schedule. It’s important to go to bed and wake up at the same time. In the ‘Bedtime’ tab, set a daily reminder for time to relax. Thanks to this, your body will set its circadian rhythm, and you’ll get the most out of your sleep!

This app is free. So, you don't have an excuse to put off good sleep until later!
